DOJO

Seishinkai Karate Federation - Shizuoka Branch

[Hokureikai - Sansenji Karate Dojo - Seishinkai Shizuoka Branch]
The Sansenji Dojo traces back to Hisanobu Inuura (Hokugo Branch Chief, now head priest of Sansenji Temple), who trained at Seishinkai Headquarters and founded the Minobusan University Karate Club in Yamanashi Prefecture in 2001 (Heisei 13).
The Sansenji Dojo itself started at Sansenji Temple in Shizuoka Prefecture in June 2005 (Heisei 17).
Members range widely from children to seniors.

Dojo / Branch Address / Venue Training Days
# Sansenji Karate Dojo (Seishinkai Shizuoka Branch) Hokureikai 332 Oshikakubo, Fujinomiya City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Sansenji Temple Wednesday - evening

※During the day we may be at work and unable to answer the phone. Training day/Wednesday evening TEL/FAX 01544-29-3500

Shizuoka Branch

◆Founded: October 2001 (Heisei 13) - Yamanashi Branch
　　　　June 2005 (Heisei 17) - Shizuoka Branch
◆Founder: Hisanobu Inuura

Venue

332 Oshikakubo, Fujinomiya City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Sansenji Temple
The dojo is located on the temple grounds
